body:
If you’ve never learned about MTR – mountain top removal – Darryl Hannah offers an excellent overview here.

I’ve had the privilege of meeting and knowing many wonderful people through the years, and one of the finest is Brent Brooks, now a pastor in Reno, NV. Here’s a good interview with him , showing characteristic balance and wisdom.
